label: 百度营销 Baidu Marketing
terms_note: Apply for 百度推广API permission in the Baidu Business Developer Center (dev2.baidu.com) with a 推广 account; REST + JSON over HTTPS; SDKs in Java / .NET / PHP referenced. Rate limits: not readable. Free.

discovery.auth: token (百度推广 API: username + password + token from the developer center; OAuth 2.0 openapi.baidu.com for some products)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (百度推广API via the 百度商业开发者中心).
auth: 1. Have a 百度推广 (search promotion) account; register in the 百度商业开发者中心 (dev2.baidu.com) and apply for 百度推广API permission.

2. Obtain the API token (developer center) and call services with header `{username, password, token, target}` (TODO(verify) — classic 百度推广API auth) or OAuth 2.0 via openapi.baidu.com for OAuth-enabled products.
3. SDKs (Java / .NET / PHP) wrap the JSON services.

endpoints.call: oCPC 转化数据回传 API (ocpx.baidu.com developer docs)

endpoints.purpose: not verified in a public doc this pass

reference.limits: - Rate limits: not readable this pass (TODO(verify)). Access by permission application at dev2.baidu.com; free API; Baidu marketing terms.
mcp_sdk: Official SDKs referenced (Java / .NET / PHP); no MCP found.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Your application's appId (商业开发者中心 → 应用管理 → 应用详情).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The application's secretKey (shown in the approved application's details).

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: refreshToken from exchanging the authorization code once at POST https://u.baidu.com/oauth/accessToken (valid 30 days; each refresh returns a new one, saved when PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR is set).

config_fields.name: user_id
config_fields.help: userId of the promotion account that authorized the app (returned by the OAuth callback / accessToken exchange).

config_fields.name: user_name
config_fields.help: 推广账户名称 (userName) of the account to operate — sent as header.userName; with a super-admin (超管) authorization this may be any sub-account.

me.note: AccountService/getAccountInfo with header {userName, accessToken}: account id, balance, budget and status (userStat 2 = active).

list_accounts.note: MccFeedService/getUserListByMccid: the sub-accounts of an account manager (账户管家) authorization — 'this interface is only for account-manager permission'. A single-account authorization has only the user_name account (see me). The id is userid; pass the username as account_id.

list_campaigns.note: CampaignService/getCampaign without campaignIds ('输入空返回整个账户的计划'): every search campaign of the account. `account_id` is the 推广账户名称 (userName) sent in the header. budget is the daily budget in CNY (null = unlimited); pause true = paused. `status` and paging are not applied.

get_report.note: OpenApiReportService/getReportData, 计划报告 (reportType 2290316) per DAY: impressions, clicks, cost (CNY), ctr, cpc and conversions per campaign; values are strings. `account_id` is the userName sent in the header. `campaign_id` is not applied — filter the rows by campaign_id (the report's campaignId column). Max range 731 days; up to 10,000 rows.

update_budget.note: CampaignService/updateCampaign {campaignTypes: [{campaignId, budget}]}: the campaign's daily budget in CNY, range [50, min(10,000,000, account budget)]. `currency` is not applied (CNY). A refused update answers with no campaign record (the reason is in header.failures).

pause_resume.note: CampaignService/updateCampaign {campaignTypes: [{campaignId, pause}]}: pause true = 暂停, false = 启用.

adapter.terms: 百度营销 API (https://dev2.baidu.com/content?sceneType=0&pageId=100441&nodeId=421): developer permission and an approved application are required; the advertiser authorizes the app once through the OAuth page and the app refreshes its accessToken (24 h) with the refreshToken (30 days). Every call is a JSON POST {header: {userName, accessToken}, body: {…}}; header.status 0 = success, 1 = partial, 2 = failure (https://dev2.baidu.com/content?sceneType=0&pageId=100142&nodeId=255).

evidence: host api.baidu.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.2 (GlobalSign nv-sa)
probe: 6/6 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 405 (method_not_allowed), so the answers are path-specific

HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 4/5 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; names not found on the page: get_report:body, get_report:header, list_accounts:body, list_campaigns:body, list_campaigns:header, pause_resume:body, pause_resume:header, update_budget:body, update_budget:header
auth_audit.notes: Fixed: errors come back as HTTP 200 {header: {desc: failure, failures[]}}, which the tools reported as empty successes; envelope fail_when header.desc=failure added.
